mapper.insert: INSERT INTO scm_quote (quote_id, tenant_id, supplier_id, seller_sku, currency, unit_price, total_price, quoted_quantity, lead_time_days, status, valid_until, remark, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{quoteId}, #{tenantId}, #{supplierId}, #{sellerSku}, #{currency}, #{unitPrice}, #{totalPrice}, #{quotedQuantity}, #{leadTimeDays}, #{status}, #{validUntil}, #{remark}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE scm_quote SET status = #{status}, remark = #{remark}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE quote_id = #{quoteId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}
mapper.select: SELECT quote_id, tenant_id, supplier_id, seller_sku, currency, unit_price, total_price, quoted_quantity, lead_time_days, status, valid_until, remark, created_at, updated_at FROM scm_quote WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND supplier_id = #{supplierId} ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT quote_id, tenant_id, supplier_id, seller_sku, currency, unit_price, total_price, quoted_quantity, lead_time_days, status, valid_until, remark, created_at, updated_at FROM scm_quote WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND seller_sku = #{sellerSku} ORDER BY unit_price ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO scm_supplier_score (score_id, tenant_id, supplier_id, quality_score, delivery_score, price_score, service_score, overall_score, evaluation_count, scored_at) VALUES (#{scoreId}, #{tenantId}, #{supplierId}, #{qualityScore}, #{deliveryScore}, #{priceScore}, #{serviceScore}, #{overallScore}, #{evaluationCount}, #{scoredAt})
mapper.select: SELECT approval_id, tenant_id, po_id, approval_level, status, approver_id, comment, approved_at, created_at FROM scm_purchase_approval WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND approval_id = #{approvalId}

SELECT approval_id, tenant_id, po_id, approval_level, status, approver_id, comment, approved_at, created_at FROM scm_purchase_approval WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND approver_id = #{approverId} AND status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY approval_level ASC, created_at ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO scm_processing_order (process_id, tenant_id, name, raw_materials, output_sku, output_quantity, total_cost, currency, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{processId}, #{tenantId}, #{name}, #{rawMaterials}, #{outputSku}, #{outputQuantity}, #{totalCost}, #{currency}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT process_id, tenant_id, name, raw_materials, output_sku, output_quantity, total_cost, currency, status, created_at, updated_at FROM scm_processing_order WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE scm_purchase_tracking SET seller_sku = #{sellerSku}, ordered_quantity = #{orderedQuantity}, received_quantity = #{receivedQuantity}, pending_quantity = #{pendingQuantity}, damaged_quantity = #{damagedQuantity}, returned_quantity = #{returnedQuantity}, ordered_unit_cost = #{orderedUnitCost}, actual_unit_cost = #{actualUnitCost}, status = #{status}, last_received_at = #{lastReceivedAt}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND po_id = #{poId} AND line_id = #{lineId}
mapper.select: SELECT tracking_id, tenant_id, po_id, line_id, seller_sku, ordered_quantity, received_quantity, pending_quantity, damaged_quantity, returned_quantity, ordered_unit_cost, actual_unit_cost, status, last_received_at, created_at, updated_at FROM scm_purchase_tracking WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND po_id = #{poId} AND line_id = #{lineId}

SELECT tracking_id, tenant_id, po_id, line_id, seller_sku, ordered_quantity, received_quantity, pending_quantity, damaged_quantity, returned_quantity, ordered_unit_cost, actual_unit_cost, status, last_received_at, created_at, updated_at FROM scm_purchase_tracking WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND po_id = #{poId} ORDER BY created_at ASC, line_id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE scm_purchase_exception SET line_id = #{lineId}, seller_sku = #{sellerSku}, exception_type = #{exceptionType}, expected_value = #{expectedValue}, actual_value = #{actualValue}, description = #{description}, status = #{status}, handler_id = #{handlerId}, handler_note = #{handlerNote}, handled_at = #{handledAt} WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND exception_id = #{exceptionId}
mapper.select: SELECT exception_id, tenant_id, po_id, line_id, seller_sku, exception_type, expected_value, actual_value, description, status, handler_id, handler_note, created_at, handled_at FROM scm_purchase_exception WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND exception_id = #{exceptionId}

SELECT exception_id, tenant_id, po_id, line_id, seller_sku, exception_type, expected_value, actual_value, description, status, handler_id, handler_note, created_at, handled_at FROM scm_purchase_exception WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND po_id = #{poId} ORDER BY created_at ASC, exception_id ASC

SELECT exception_id, tenant_id, po_id, line_id, seller_sku, exception_type, expected_value, actual_value, description, status, handler_id, handler_note, created_at, handled_at FROM scm_purchase_exception WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'PROCESSING') ORDER BY created_at ASC, exception_id ASC
